hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps through Euler vaults as liquidity sources. Swap execution is handled entirely in beforeSwap: it deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, verifies a proprietary curve invariant, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to the pool manager. Standard liquidity provision and donations are blocked via reverts.
